prompts.title: Boy Stylish portrait with SUV and panda
prompts.prompt:
Cinematic full-body portrait of a [young man] with [naturally styled hair, and aviator sunglasses], wearing a white leather biker jacket over a black t-shirt, thin silver chain necklace, white slim-fit trousers, and brown leather loafers with no socks. He leans casually against the front driver-side fender of a white luxury SUV (Range Rover style), one leg crossed over the other, one hand in his pocket, gazing off to the side with a confident, relaxed expression.

The SUV faces the camera at a slight three-quarter angle. Headlights blazing a saturated golden-yellow with visible bloom and lens flare. Metallic gold multi-spoke alloy wheels, black accent trim on the doors and hood vents, dark tinted panoramic roof, custom license plate "[MF 007]". Underglow lighting is physically integrated into the vehicle: a hidden LED strip is mounted flush beneath the rocker panels and front splitter, tucked directly against the underside of the car body so the light source itself is not visible — only its glow is. This creates a tight, sharp pool of saturated yellow-gold light emanating from directly under the chassis, hugging the contours of the front splitter and side skirts, with the light visibly touching and wrapping the lower edge of the car body (no gap or floating line between the car and the light). The glow bleeds outward onto the damp asphalt in a soft gradient, brightest right at the point of contact with the tires and rocker panels, fading within a short radius — concentrated and vivid, not a separate glowing bar.

Beside the man, a small fluffy giant panda stands upright on the asphalt, playfully raising one paw toward him, its fur catching a warm rim of yellow light from the underglow.

Setting: a smooth, slightly damp asphalt road curving through hills, deep blue hour just after sunset. Flowering trees arch fully over the road forming a dense canopy across the top of the frame, thick with vivid magenta-pink bougainvillea and bright golden-yellow blossoms intermixed on the same branches, petals scattered on the road. Hazy blue mountain ridges in the far background. The sky is deep saturated twilight blue, not grey or foggy.

Lighting and color grade: strong teal-and-orange / blue-and-gold split. Ambient light is cool, deep cobalt blue filling all shadows and the road surface. All warm light comes only from the car — headlights, underglow, and its reflections — creating high contrast between cool environment and warm accents. Rich, punchy saturation on the flowers, wheels, and lights. Slightly lifted blacks with a blue tint, high clarity, crisp micro-contrast. Dramatic rim lighting on the subject and panda. No fog, no haze in the foreground, no muted or washed-out tones. Skin tones natural with a subtle cool cast, realistic skin pores and subsurface scattering.
